Replication // Animated // Example

A write is committed after both followers acknowledge it

The leader appends first, replicates to both followers, and answers the client only when both have the entry.

Write path

Steps

  1. 01WriteThe client sends entry 42 to the leader and waits.
  2. 02AppendThe leader appends 42 to its own log.
  3. 03ReplicateThe leader sends 42 to both followers at once.
  4. 04AcknowledgeEach follower appends 42 and acknowledges.
  5. 05CommitThe leader marks 42 committed and answers the client.
